dashboard.intro: The sections build on each other: the year sets the boundaries, classes live inside it, and each class has a schedule and a plan. The list below walks you through it.

demo.title: Nothing to start from?
demo.hint: Let's build an example: a year with breaks and quarters, two classes, a schedule for the whole year and a plan for one of the classes. See how it all fits together, then remove it with one button.

warnings.slot_not_study_day: {{date}} is not a study day ({{statusLabel}}{{titleSuffix}}) — the lesson sits outside the school calendar.

errors.other_school: That object belongs to another school.
errors.course_in_use: «{{name}}» is in use: it holds {{plan_rows}} curriculum rows, plus {{slots}} lessons and {{works}} assignments. Clear it first.
errors.course_name_taken: A course with this name already exists in this year.
errors.invitation_exists: «{{email}}» has already been invited to this school.
errors.last_admin: This is the only administrator of the school. Give the role to somebody else first.
errors.superuser_required: Only a superuser can manage the list of schools.
errors.school_in_use: «{{name}}» is still in use: {{blocked_by}}. Clear it first.
errors.not_template_author: Only the author can change this plan. Take a copy and edit that.
errors.subject_required: Pick a subject: the library is searched by subject and grade.

errors.attachment_forbidden: This attachment belongs to somebody else's lesson.
errors.file_type_not_allowed: This kind of file cannot be attached: «{{extension}}». Allowed: images, pdf, docx, xlsx, pptx, txt, zip.
errors.school_quota_exceeded: The school has used up its storage quota ({{quota_mb}} MB). Remove some files to make room.
errors.storage_unavailable: The file store is not answering. Everything else works; try the file again in a moment.
errors.csv_id_unknown: Row {{row}}: id {{id}} is not in this plan.
errors.csv_id_kind_changed: Row {{row}}: id {{id}} («{{title}}») is a theme in the plan, not a lesson.
errors.grade_in_use: «{{name}}» is used by {{courses}} courses — change them first.
errors.assignment_in_use: {{teacher}} has {{slots}} lessons in «{{course}}», and the course keeps its {{plan_rows}} curriculum rows. Unassigning keeps all of it.

errors.csv_row_too_long: Row {{row}}: the title is longer than {{limit}} characters.

errors.reviewer_required: This course has several methodists — choose one.
errors.not_a_methodist: That person does not approve the plan of this course.
errors.comment_required: Say what to fix — a plan returned without a word is a riddle.
errors.review_closed: This request is no longer waiting for a decision.
errors.year_in_use: The year is in use: its courses hold {{plan_rows}} curriculum rows and {{slots}} lessons. Clear them first.
errors.email_other_kind: «{{email}}» is already used by an account of the other kind: one address is either a teacher or a student.
errors.not_a_student: A student cannot be an administrator of the school.
errors.roster_empty: There is not a single address in what was pasted.
errors.roster_bad_email: Line {{line}}: «{{email}}» is not an email address.
errors.roster_two_emails: Line {{line}}: two addresses in one line.
errors.roster_too_many_columns: Line {{line}}: {{columns}} columns — a name and an address are expected.
errors.roster_too_many_rows: Not more than {{limit}} lines at a time.
errors.year_shrink_cuts_slots: The new boundaries leave {{slots}} lessons outside the year. They are not deleted, but they stop being part of it.
errors.work_not_open: This work has not opened yet.
errors.work_closed: The work is closed: answers are no longer accepted.
errors.not_in_course: You are no longer in this course. What you have done stays visible.
errors.attempts_exhausted: No attempts left for this task.
errors.work_dates_reversed: The work closes before it opens.
errors.not_course_teacher: Only the teacher of this course or a school administrator can change this.
errors.file_not_pdf: That file is not a PDF, or it cannot be read.
errors.too_many_criteria: A work is graded by at most {{limit}} criteria.
errors.criterion_unknown: That criterion does not belong to this work.
errors.mark_out_of_range: The mark is above the maximum of {{maximum}}.
errors.split_empty: Nothing is marked up: say which pages belong to whom.
errors.split_out_of_range: Those pages are outside the file, which has {{pages}}.
errors.split_overlap: Page {{page}} is given to two students at once.
errors.split_student_twice: One student is named twice: a work is one piece, however many sheets it takes.
errors.split_not_in_course: That student does not study in this course.
errors.not_on_paper: This work is not written on paper: there is nothing to split.
errors.plan_lesson_taught: «{{title}}» was taught on {{date}}: a lesson already given keeps its place.
errors.attachment_title_required: A text resource is its title — it cannot be empty.
errors.slot_record_out_of_order: Close the lesson on {{date}} first: records go in order, without gaps.
errors.slot_record_not_last: Only the last record of the course — {{date}} — can be changed.
errors.slot_record_future: The lesson has not happened yet: only the past is recorded.
errors.slot_record_no_row: The plan has no row left for this hour — add one first.
errors.slot_record_not_suggested: The layout puts «{{title}}» in this hour: rows are recorded in order.
errors.plan_before_taught: «{{title}}» has already been taught — a lesson not yet given cannot go before it
errors.slot_move_breaks_order: The move would leave {{date}} unrecorded among closed lessons: records go one after another, without gaps
errors.plan_delete_taught: «{{title}}» was taught on {{date}} — withdraw the record before deleting the row
errors.plan_bulk_section: «{{title}}» is a theme — delete it on its own row, where the question about its lessons is asked
errors.rows_invalid: The paste could not be read: send the table rows.
errors.slot_delete_recorded: «{{title}}» is recorded on {{date}} — withdraw the record before deleting the lesson
errors.slot_cancel_recorded: «{{title}}» is recorded here — withdraw the record before cancelling the lesson

clear.title: Clear the period
clear.keepSpecial: leave extra and cancelled lessons alone

copy.title: Copy the schedule
copy.source: Source: {{range}} — {{days}}. Weekdays line up: Mondays land on Mondays.
copy.modeMerge: add to what is already there
copy.preview: About {{created}} lessons will be created, {{skipped}} skipped (non-study days and taken numbers).
copy.checkPeriod: Check the period and the selected classes.

csv.title: Import a plan
csv.hint: Two formats, same table: {{header}}, one row is one lesson. xlsx is the safer one — no encodings, no delimiters, no quotes around commas.
csv.dropZone: Drag an .xlsx or .csv file here or choose one
csv.unreadable: The file could not be read — a plain text CSV is expected.
csv.newSections: New themes: {{count}} — a theme renamed on some rows only splits in two.

mode.replaceHint: wipe the plan and build it again from the file
mode.appendHint: add the rows to the end, ids ignored
mode.syncHint: match rows by id, keeping the lesson content
mode.nothingToSync: no row carries an id — nothing to sync with

csv.loss: {{lessons}} lessons will be deleted, {{content}} of them with content and {{attachments}} with attachments.
csv.filesLost_one: {{count}} file will be gone for good.
csv.filesLost_other: {{count}} files will be gone for good.
csv.deleteOnlyTitles: Nothing but titles and notes is being deleted.
csv.confirmLoss_one: I understand: the content of {{count}} lesson will be deleted.
csv.confirmLoss_other: I understand: the content of {{count}} lessons will be deleted.
csv.refused: The file cannot be applied — it is taken whole or not at all:
csv.replaceWarning: The current plan of the course will be deleted in full.
csv.sheetUsed_one: Read the sheet «{{sheet}}»; {{count}} more sheet in the book is left alone.
csv.sheetUsed_other: Read the sheet «{{sheet}}»; {{count}} more sheets in the book are left alone.

paste.about: Copy the rows in Excel and paste them here — the columns sort themselves out. The header is optional.
paste.hint: The paste starts at the selected cell — click «Тема» first if your table has no id column. Drag across cells and press Delete to clear them.
paste.tooBig: More than {{count}} rows — a table that size is easier to import as a file.

plan.title: Curriculum map
plan.addToSection: Add a lesson to the theme
plan.pickNothing: Nothing selected — tick the rows you want to delete

dropPicked.title: Delete {{lessons}}?
dropPicked.cost: {{content}} of them have content and {{attachments}} have attachments.

plan.dndInstructions: Press space to pick the item up. Choose a new place with the up and down arrows, press space to drop it, Escape cancels the move. The arrow buttons in the row do the same.

needClass.title: A course first
needClass.hint: A plan is written for a particular course — each one has its own list of themes and lessons.

empty.title: The plan is empty
empty.hint: A list of sections and lessons in order. It will be laid onto the dates of the schedule, and you will see whether the hours last until the end of the year. Add a lesson with the button above or import a ready list from a file.

removeSection.title: Delete the theme «{{title}}»?
removeSection.hint: It holds {{count}}. They can be lifted to the top level — they take the theme's place and keep their order.
removeSection.confirmLoss: I understand: {{content}} of them have content and {{attachments}} have attachments, and it all goes.
removeSection.taught: Some lessons here have already been taught — the section cannot go together with them: withdraw the records first.

plan.toEveryoneHint: Teachers of the school will find it on the shelf and can take it into their own courses. Your course plan is not affected: the shelf holds a snapshot.
plan.toMyselfHint: A draft: nobody else sees it. You can publish it later, on the shelf.
plan.refreshHint: «{{title}}» will be overwritten with the current plan of this course. Colleagues who already took a copy keep theirs.

csvHelp.formats: Two formats, one table. xlsx is preferred: a workbook has no encoding, no delimiter and no quoting, so a comma inside a title is just a comma. csv stays for those who want a plain text file.

rules.oneRow: One row is one lesson — there is no row for a theme of its own.
rules.repeat: The theme is repeated on every row; a new theme starts where the value changes.
rules.emptyTheme: An empty theme means the lesson sits outside any theme.
rules.emptyId: An empty id means the lesson is new; keep the id and the row is recognised.

csvHelp.keeps: Lesson content, notes and attachments are not in the file and stay in the system: bring the file back as «Sync» and they survive. A theme without lessons is not written to the file.

modes.sync: rows are matched by id — titles, notes and order change, content stays.
modes.append: the rows are added to the end, ids are ignored, nothing is deleted.
modes.replace: the plan is wiped and built again from the file — content and attachments go with it.

summary.notStarted_one: lesson has passed — no records yet
summary.notStarted_other: lessons have passed — no records yet
summary.startRecording: Open the first lesson that has passed

baseline.hint: A snapshot goes to the methodist of the course; «My courses» on the main page then counts the drift from what was approved.
baseline.youReview: You are the methodist for this course.

plan.publishFromCourse: The subject and the year of study come from the course: {{subject}}, year {{grade}}.
plan.unclosedHint: The lesson is past and unmarked
plan.recordedHint: The lesson is taught and recorded
plan.beforeTaught: There is no room before a lesson already taught

diff.title: What changed since approval
diff.none: The plan has never been approved — nothing to compare with.
diff.legend: Green is added, red is deleted, yellow is edited, blue is moved.

plan.splitTail_one: {{count}} lesson moves into the new theme
plan.splitTail_other: {{count}} lessons move into the new theme

status.overflow_one: {{count}} lesson does not fit the year
status.overflow_other: {{count}} lessons do not fit the year
status.grown: against the baseline of {{date}} — a stretched topic shows up here too
status.pastYear: the plan ends on {{date}}, past the end of the year ({{year}})
status.recordedShare: Recorded for {{confirmed}} of {{held}} lessons held; the rest is worked out from the order.

calendar.title: School year

empty.title: No school year yet
empty.hint: A school year sets the boundaries lessons are counted inside. Breaks, holidays and terms are marked up here too.
empty.askAdmin: A school year is created by the school administrator.

exceptions.title: Markup
exceptions.typicalHint: autumn, winter and spring — you can move the dates later.
exceptions.hint: Click a day to mark a holiday, or drag across several days to make a break.
exceptions.wholePeriod: «{{title}}» covers a whole period — delete it in the list on the right.

terms.title: Terms
terms.empty: No quarters yet. Without them the layout is counted over the whole year at once.
terms.emptyReadOnly: No quarters have been marked up in this school yet.

calendar.readOnly: The calendar belongs to the school — only an administrator edits it.

removeYear.title: Delete the school year «{{name}}»?
removeYear.blocked: The courses of this year hold other people's work: {{slots}} lessons and {{rows}} plan rows. The year cannot be deleted while they are there — their teachers have to clear them first.

agenda.title: My schedule
agenda.copyNote: Cancelled and extra lessons are not copied, and the display filter does not affect copying.

empty.title: The schedule is empty
empty.hint: Mark up one week of lessons and copy it across the year — breaks and holidays are skipped automatically. But a class comes first: lessons belong to a class.

add.title: {{date}}, lesson {{number}}
add.nobody: Nobody can take this lesson: every suitable class already has that number taken, the date is outside the school year, or no classes exist yet.

menu.title: {{className}}, lesson {{number}}
menu.moveHint: The old hour stays cancelled and a make-up lesson appears on the new date.

noSchool.title: You do not belong to a school yet
noSchool.hint: The tracker works inside a school: the calendar and the courses come from it. Ask your school administrator to invite this address — they need it exactly as it is written below.

year.title: School year
year.hint: The calendar is shared: the boundaries of the year, the breaks and the quarters are the same for everybody in the school.

courses.title: Courses
courses.hint: A course is a group and a subject together, «9B Algebra». Teachers pick from this list; their lessons and plans inside a course stay their own.
courses.invitedGroup: Invited, has not signed in yet
courses.pendingHint: The course is waiting for {{email}}: it becomes theirs the first time they sign in. If somebody else is put on it before that, they keep it.
courses.needGrades: There are no year groups yet — add them in «Reference lists».

next.year: Start with the school year: everything else lives inside it.
next.courses: Now add the courses — a year group and a subject together, «9B Algebra».
next.assignments: Now say who teaches what: open «Teachers» or «Courses».
next.timetable: The last step is the school timetable, which teachers copy into their own.

teachers.title: Teachers
teachers.hint: Everybody who has signed in at least once. A course handed to somebody appears in their lists — lessons, plan, layout.
teachers.keepsWork: The lessons and the plan stay where they are — only the assignment goes.
teachers.detachKeeps: Their lessons and plans are kept; the assignments and the role are removed.

invitations.title: Invited
invitations.hint: Written down in advance: the person signs in through Google on that address and joins the school.
invitations.none: Nobody is waiting for a first sign-in.

reference.subjectsHint: What is taught: «Algebra», «Geometry». The library is searched by subject and year group.
reference.name: Name
reference.gradesEmpty: No year groups yet. A course needs one, so start with the usual set:
reference.presetHint: Or add them one at a time below. Names can be changed afterwards; «Grade 9» becomes «MYP 4» in one click.
reference.levelExplain: The ordinal year counted from the first one, not the number inside the name. «MYP 4» is the ninth year of study, so its year is 9 — that is what every list sorts by.
reference.levelLocked: Courses use this year group, so its year of study is fixed — the sorting of every list depends on it. The name can still be changed.
reference.clearConfirm_one: Delete {{count}} year group no course uses?
reference.clearConfirm_other: Delete {{count}} year groups no course uses?

students.title: Students of the school
students.hint: Everybody enrolled in any course. Enrolment itself happens in the course card; here you can find a person and detach them from the school.
students.noneHint: Students are added to a course roster:
students.detachKeeps: Nothing is deleted: the person is taken off every course, and what they have done stays.

schools.title: Schools
schools.hint: Every school in this installation. Creating one and handing it its first administrator cannot be done from inside a school — that is what this section is for.
schools.invited: «{{email}}» is invited to {{name}} as an administrator — they will get in through Google on that address.

empty.title: No schools yet
empty.hint: Create the first one and invite its administrator: everything else — the calendar, the courses, the teachers — they set up themselves.

schoolSchedule.title: School timetable
schoolSchedule.hint: Who teaches what and when. Everybody reads it; the course teacher or an administrator edits it — one schedule, not a copy.
schoolSchedule.copyNote: Cancellations and substitutions are neither copied nor wiped when a period is replaced: bulk edits leave hand-made markup alone.

library.subject: Subject:
library.once: The plan is copied into the course. Later changes to the template will not affect your copy.

empty.hint: Nothing has been put on the shelf yet. Publish one of your plans, or write a new one.

placeholders.objectives: MYP objectives this lesson works towards
placeholders.body: Theory and problems. Markdown, maths in $…$ and $$…$$
placeholders.formative: A short check done in the lesson

lesson.discard: The lesson has unsaved changes. Close and lose them?
lesson.dropHere: Drop files here, or click to choose
lesson.sharedHint: The same file is used by another lesson. Removing it here leaves it there.

where.plan: A row of the {{course}} curriculum map
where.planned: Falls on {{date}} as the plan stands
where.noSlot: Does not fit into the school year
where.notTaught: the lesson has not been taught yet, and any edit above moves the date

reviews.nothingSent: No plan has been sent for approval yet.

student.title: My courses

empty.title: You are not enrolled anywhere yet
empty.hint: Courses will appear here once your school administrator enrols you.

past.title: You are no longer in these courses
past.hint: You cannot work in them, but everything you did stays visible.

student.noActive: You are not enrolled in any course at the moment.

course.noPlan: The curriculum map for this course is not written yet.
course.noWorks: No assignments in this course yet.

work.closed: The assignment is closed. Your answers and marks stay here.
work.readonly: You are no longer in this course, so answers are not accepted. What you did stays here.
work.noTasks: There are no questions in this assignment yet.
work.noAttempts: No attempts left for this question.

roster.title: Roster of «{{name}}»
roster.waiting_one: {{count}} invitation waiting for a first sign-in
roster.waiting_other: {{count}} invitations waiting for a first sign-in
roster.past_one: {{count}} person is no longer in the course
roster.past_other: {{count}} people are no longer in the course
roster.pasteHint: One person per line: an address on its own, or a name and an address separated by a comma or a tab. Repeats are collapsed; a line that cannot be read is named by its number.
roster.willDo: Will enrol: {{enrol}} · bring back: {{restore}} · invite: {{invite}} · already enrolled: {{already}}.

conflict.already_member: this address is already in another school
conflict.email_other_kind: this address belongs to a teacher

works.title: Assignments in this course
works.none: No assignments in this course yet.
works.windowHint: Students see the assignment only while the window is open. Set it in the future and it stays hidden until then.
works.attemptsHint: An attempt is spent on every submission, whether you have checked it or not.
works.showResult: Show the verdict to the student straight away
works.impact: {{students}} students have already answered here: {{answers}} answers. Editing is allowed — they will see the change immediately.
works.deleteWithTasks: Delete «{{name}}» with its {{count}} questions? The answers of the students go with it.

needCourse.title: No courses yet
needCourse.hint: An assignment belongs to a course, and courses are created by the school administrator.

task.none: No questions yet — an assignment without them shows the students an empty page.
task.question: The question
task.answersHint: One per line. «x+3» and «3+x» are both right, so write both. Leave empty if you check this one by hand.
task.deleteConfirm: Delete this question? The answers to it go with it.

grading.title: Grading
grading.emptyClears: An empty field removes the mark — zero is a mark of its own.
grading.impact: {{marks}} marks are already given to {{students}} students. A criterion you remove takes its marks with it.

hint.none: Only a comment. Works too: there is something to say about a work even when it carries no mark.
hint.simple: One number out of the maximum — the usual mark.
hint.rubric: Several criteria, each with its own maximum — the way MYP and other rubrics grade.

paper.onPaper: This work was written on paper. Your marked copy appears here once the teacher uploads it.
paper.onPaperHint: No online questions: each student gets the scan of their own work.

split.title: Split the scan into students' works
split.pick: Choose the file with all the works scanned together. It stays on your computer: only the pieces are uploaded.
split.unreadable: That file could not be read as a PDF.
split.howTo: Click the first page of every work. Pages between two marks belong to one student.

today.noTopic: The curriculum map has nothing left for this lesson.

table.noAnswers: Nobody has answered this question yet.
table.markCorrect: Mark as correct (press again to clear)
table.markWrong: Mark as wrong (press again to clear)
table.newAnswer: The student has sent a new answer while you were reading.

debts.title: Close the days nobody said anything about
debts.hint: The layout suggests a topic for each; confirm what is right and say which lessons did not happen.
debts.noTopic: the curriculum map has nothing left here

lessonScreen.noStudents: Nobody is enrolled in this course yet.
lessonScreen.planOwns: The lesson has not been taught yet. Mark it with «That is what happened» on the day, and its content, materials and homework become editable from here. Until then, edit them in the curriculum map.
lessonScreen.recordAfterHint: Records go in order: mark the previous lesson first
lessonScreen.needsRow: The plan has no row left for this hour, and a lesson is recorded as a plan row. Add one, and there will be something to mark.
